widgets.title: Total Conversation Turns
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'LocalAgent1'

widgets.title: Tool Execution Violations
widgets.query: SELECT count(*) FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE tagMap['tool.violation'] = 'true'

widgets.title: P95 Generation Latency (ms)
widgets.query: SELECT quantile(0.95)(durationNano)/1000000 FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v2 WHERE serviceName = 'LocalAgent1'
